businessRules.statement: Stations within a line MUST have strictly monotonically increasing kmPost values.
scheduleTrain.stops[] MUST be a subset of the line's stations and in same direction order.
incident.severity is derived: derailment → critical; injuries ≥ 1 → major; delay ≥ 60min → major; delay ≥ 15min → moderate; else minor. severity ≥ major triggers gov-audit social post.
Incident records are append-only. Corrections create a new incident referencing the original via supersedes.
